title: Phase 2 of harness frictions; phase 1 closed at 2026-05-08-003
body: Plan 2026-05-08-003 (`fix-harness-volley-frictions`) closed yesterday with three F-features (gate-state reconciliation, dispatch-time pre_impl auto-clear, auditor verdict taxonomy as advisory classifier). Comparing the original spec from the operator that triggered both plans, three defects remained genuinely unaddressed: (1) audit envelope verdict-mismatch detection (the operator's spec F001), (2) plan-status → gate-state sync for the non-CLI lock path (the operator's spec F002 fully — phase 1 only covered the CLI invocation trigger), and (3) environmental no_progress breaker exclusion (the operator's spec F003 fully — phase 1's classifier was advisory only). This plan ships those three. The phasing is fine: phase 1 established the typed-error patterns (GateStateReconciliationError) and the closed taxonomy this plan reuses.

title: goal_type=infra (matches surface; not omitted)
body: Plan declares `goal_type: infra` — one of the agent-conventions v1.0 enum values that does NOT require an objective_contract (mechanical / infra / refactor are the contract-exempt set). This plan tightens harness behavior; it's not an operator-facing journey (parity), new product capability (new_feature), code reorganization (refactor), or migration. infra is the closest honest fit. (Earlier draft incorrectly claimed plan 2026-05-08-003 had goal_type omitted; in fact 2026-05-08-003 has goal_type=parity with an objective_contract. The honest precedent is plan 2026-05-09-001, which omits goal_type entirely. We chose infra over omission so the field is explicit rather than inheriting the v1.0 default.)

title: F001 follows command_guard / GateStateReconciliationError pattern
body: F001 adds VerdictMismatchError as a typed exception with named fields (plan_id, feature_id, iteration, structured_status, narrative_verdict, audit_path, remediation). The shape and discipline mirror gate_pause.GateStateReconciliationError landed in plan 2026-05-08-003 F001: pure parser, no schema mutation, fail-loud + INBOX classification event, no auto-repair. Operators inspect the artifact and decide. Same rationale: silent disagreement is the worst kind of harness defect. Narrative-verdict regex is line-anchored and conservative — only matches canonical lead-in patterns ('Verdict: X', 'Overall verdict: X.', '**Verdict: X**') so quoted text or recommendation prose does not trigger false mismatches.

title: F002 keeps reconcile_gate_state pure; sync runs in a separate post-reconcile step
body: An earlier draft of F002 proposed adding a `plan_status_active` kwarg to `gate_pause.reconcile_gate_state` and writing the implicit clearance from inside that helper. That violates the function's documented contract added in plan 2026-05-08-003 F001: 'No mutation to gate-state.json regardless of outcome (D004).' Reconciliation must remain a read-only check that either returns a CompatGateState or raises. F002 of THIS plan instead adds a NEW mutating helper `gate_pause.implicit_clear_pre_impl_for_active_plan` next to `approve_gate` / `record_pause`, and the supervisor invokes it AFTER reconcile_gate_state returns successfully. The sync is post-reconcile, not in-reconcile. This preserves the read-only contract that the F001 fail-loud reconciliation depends on.

title: F003 short-circuits the volley on first env-only round (does NOT exclude from counter)
body: An earlier draft of F003 proposed having env-only auditor rounds 'not count toward the no_progress counter.' That shape solves the wrong problem: if env-only rounds don't increment the counter, the volley keeps iterating until max_iterations, paying for MORE implementer + auditor rounds on a dispatch the agents demonstrably can't complete. The actual goal — stop paying for environmentally-doomed volleys — requires terminating earlier, not later. F003 of THIS plan instead short-circuits on the FIRST env-only auditor round, before another implementer round dispatches. Final status is a new distinct breaker terminal `stopped_environmental_blocker` (not `stopped_no_progress`), so downstream consumers (signoff_writer, completion_gate, breaker_history) can tell which cause fired. Plan 2026-05-08-003 F003 D006's invariant — 'implementation_defect, mixed, and unknown remain blocking and never auto-sign-off' — still holds: the env terminal is non-success, the operator runs local verification and either provides evidence (operator-verified close) or the volley stays blocked. This is behavior-changing but not auto-signoff.

title: Pre-flight env-capability check (spec F003 Option 2) deferred
body: The operator's original spec for F003 included a second option: 'supervisor warns at dispatch time when target env can't run tests the plan implies (e.g. plan touches android/ but env has no Android SDK).' That requires a host-capability registry that does not exist — supervisor would need to know which capabilities are available on the current host (Android SDK, Xcode, gcloud auth, simulator boot state, etc.) to enumerate what's missing. Building that registry is its own platform-integrity plan, not a step inside this plan. F003 here ships the breaker-exclusion piece (Option 1) which is the load-bearing fix; the pre-flight warning becomes a separate feat plan when prioritized.

title: Lock ceremony viable here; manual-direct path optional
body: Unlike plan 2026-05-08-003 (which had to skip lock because the lock gate consumed F003's sufficiency-auditor surface that 2026-05-08-003 F003 was repairing), this plan does NOT touch the F003 sufficiency-auditor surface, the F002 pre_impl auto-clear surface (extends it), or the F001 reconciliation surface (extends it). `dontpanic plan lock` should run cleanly. The operator may choose manual-direct execution for speed, but unlike 2026-05-08-003 the ceremony itself is not blocked.

title: Draft revisions in response to design review
body: Pre-implementation review surfaced four issues with the original draft: (1) F003's exclude-from-counter shape would have INCREASED paid iterations rather than reducing them; (2) F002's proposed mutation inside reconcile_gate_state violated the read-only contract from plan 2026-05-08-003 F001; (3) F002 referenced plan-status values that don't exist in the agent-conventions v1.0 enum (no `proposed`, no `locked` — actual values are `draft / active / ready_for_audit / in_audit / completed / abandoned / blocked`); (4) D002 falsely claimed plan 2026-05-08-003 had goal_type omitted (it has goal_type=parity). All four corrected before implementation begins: F003 reshaped to first-round short-circuit with a new breaker terminal; F002 split into reconcile (pure) + post-reconcile sync (mutating, in a separate helper); F002 trigger narrowed to `status == 'active'` exactly; this plan declares `goal_type=infra` honestly. Design-review-before-implementation is the right loop discipline.

title: Plan close-out: F001 + F002 + F003 all green; full orchestrate sweep at 1588 passed
body: Plan 2026-05-09-002 closes with all three features implemented and verified. F001 (verdict-mismatch detector + typed VerdictMismatchError + INBOX event) shipped at commit 9324360. F002 (plan-status='active' implicit pre_impl clearance via post-reconcile sync helper, reconcile_gate_state stays documented-pure per D004) shipped at b0db69a. F003 (environmental volley short-circuit via new BreakerKind.ENVIRONMENTAL_BLOCKER + APPROVAL_BREAKERS membership + dispatch_volley branch BEFORE no_progress) shipped in this commit. Full orchestrate sweep: 1588 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed (net +43 over the pre-F001 baseline of 1545; +16 from F003 alone). Two pre-existing tests touched by F003: test_breaker_kind_enum_values_unchanged snapshot extended to include environmental_blocker; test_environmental_no_progress_emits_classification repurposed to use scope_overreach (env-only path no longer reaches no_progress). Manual-direct discipline per D003/D008 — plan ID/folder remained `dontpanic` brand throughout per the plan-ID brand policy memory.
